dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Getting a good rest is indeed key to being productive in one's work.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: This bedroom has everything, except for one item: it needs a clock to gauge time with.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I'll find some time to accompany you to shop for a clock, lest you oversleep and miss something important.
